test_title: PYST 34: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 28 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a row of 22 students facing north, Mayank is 15th from the left end. If Payal is 7th to the right of Mayank, what is Payal's position from the right end of the line?
solution:
Total students = 22

 
• They are all facing north (so left-to-right order is natural).
 
• Mayank is 15th from the left end.
 
• So, his position from the left = 15.
 
• Payal is 7th to the right of Mayank.
 
• That means Payal’s position from the left = 15 + 7 = 22.
 
• Total students = 22.
 
• Position from the right = Total – Position from left + 1
 
• = 22 – 22 + 1
 
• = 1.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
